fields.proposed_value: Scope session with the VP of Admissions and the CIO. Agreed scope: 120 users across admissions, marketing and management, with Campus One, Mailwave and WhatsApp integrations; student data must stay in Brazil. Budget is USD 110k-130k per year, Clarion Sales Cloud is also evaluated, and go-live is needed by May 2027. Lumen asked for a proposal; Orbita will send it by 13 Nov and review it with them on 17 Nov.
